title: E-Learning Module Content
description: Schema for the content.json that drives an e-learning module built from the shell template. Each module = course meta + brand + units (sidebar outline) + slides (one slide object per unit, with type-specific data) + glossary + narration + optional cheat-sheet/hint/resources. For per-type field docs and examples see references/slide_types.md.

code.description: Course code shown in header badge. E.g., 'PP/SOP/C1-050 REV-3'.

logo.description: Path to logo image relative to module root, e.g., 'assets/logo.png'.

bypassQuiz.description: Bypass quiz requirement for testing certificate printing directly without completing the quiz.

gatingSeconds.description: Duration in seconds each slide is locked before user can navigate forward

maxQuizAttempts.description: Maximum number of quiz attempts allowed before permanent lock

webhookUrl.description: Optional Google Apps Script webhook URL to sync quiz results and analytics to Google Sheets

resourcesDesc.description: Description text under the Lampiran/Resources sidebar tab (build-time placeholder __COURSE_RESOURCES_DESC__).

glossarySearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder for the Terminologi search box.

certificate.description: Print-to-PDF certificate customisation. Runtime values (recipient name/NIP, score, date, registration number) are always injected by the engine; everything here controls layout, language and page geometry.

template.description: Path (relative to content.json) to a custom HTML template that replaces the inner markup of #certificatePrintArea. Supports {{token}} build-time tokens; must expose the DOM ids certRecipientName, certRecipientNIP, certScoreVal, certDateVal, certNumberLabel.

pageSize.description: CSS @page size used by the print stylesheet.

pageWidthMm.description: Override the printed area width in mm (defaults to the pageSize width).

pageHeightMm.description: Override the printed area height in mm (defaults to the pageSize height).

printPadding.description: Padding around the printed certificate area, e.g. '15mm' or '0' for edge-to-edge designs.

dateLocale.description: BCP-47 locale used by toLocaleDateString() for the graduation date.

regNumberFormat.description: Registration-number pattern. Supported fields: {prefix} (brand certRegPrefix), {year}, {seq} (deterministic per participant+course+year).

regSequenceDigits.description: Zero-padded width of the {seq} registration field.

labels.description: Overridable built-in certificate labels (use English or any other language).

passNote.description: Safe HTML allowed. Rendered before the brand certTitle.

passThresholdNote.description: Use {passingScore} to interpolate the course passing score.

brand.description: Brand profile. Either `preset` (resolved from brand.profiles.json at build time) OR inline fields. Inline fields override preset fields.

wide.description: When true the cheat-sheet card spans both grid columns (reference module renders its final card as sm:col-span-2).

body.description: Optional HTML body appended after desc.

heroMeta.description: Small mono text shown above hero title, e.g., 'PP/SOP/C1-050 · REV-3 · Berlaku 31 Des 2024'.

skipTo.description: Slide index the CTA button jumps to. Default 1.

reasons.description: Grid of icon cards (typically 4). Shown below the hero.

id.description: Stable id referenced by flowCard keys and hotspot lookups.

actorColor.description: Tailwind class string for the actor badge.

flowCard.description: Map of stepId -> { t (title), out? (output label), branches? ([[condition, action], ...]) }.

id.description: DOM-safe id used to wire verdict panel.

legend.description: Text of the sky-blue legend pill shown on the verification panels. Defaults to 'PIC Khusus'.

defaultPic.description: Fallback verifier label used when a row does not set its own PIC.

chip.description: Prefix for this tab's record-number chips, e.g. '8.' renders 8.01, 8.02. Defaults to a zero-padded index.

clauseLabel.description: Override for the clause chip prefix. Defaults to 'Klausul'.

criticalLabel.description: Override for the amber critical-process pill. Defaults to 'Proses Kritis'.

riskLabel.description: Override for the risk panel heading. Defaults to 'Potensi Risiko Lapangan:'.

mitigationLabel.description: Override for the mitigation panel heading. Defaults to 'Mitigasi Preventif SOP:'.

webhookUrl.description: Optional Google Apps Script webhook URL specifically for this quiz

askParticipantInfo.description: Whether to render participant identity fields (name, NIP, jabatan, divisi) before or during quiz

acceptedAnswers.description: Any of these (case-insensitive, trimmed) is accepted.

correctIndexes.description: Every correct option index. Graded as an exact set: all of them, no extras.

items.description: Steps listed in the CORRECT order. The engine shuffles them for display.

correctOrder.description: Optional explicit permutation of item indices; omit when `items` is already correct.

pairs.description: Each entry is a CORRECT left→right pair. The right column is shuffled for display.

tolerance.description: Absolute tolerance accepted around `answer`. Omit for an exact match.

unit.description: Unit label shown after the input, e.g. 'hari' or '%'.

heroTitle.description: Shown on the score hero card.

failMessage.description: Shown when user hasn't passed the quiz yet.

src.description: YouTube/Vimeo URL or direct mp4 path.

icon.description: Material Symbols name; defaults to variant (info/warning/success/danger).

cells.description: Map of columnKey -> cell content (HTML allowed).

checkpointBlock.description: Optional formative practice question rendered below the slide content. It never affects the score, the attempt counter or the webhook; answering it correctly just releases the slide gate early. See references/interactivity_patterns.md.

prompt.description: Panel heading, e.g. 'Cek pemahaman' or 'Sebelum lanjut'.

hotspotImage.description: Image with clickable hotspots: labeled graphic (explore) or a locate-the-target exercise (find). Always formative — never scored.

src.description: Image path relative to the module, or a data: URI to keep the module single-file.

alt.description: Required alt text; the image carries the teaching content.

mode.description: explore = every hotspot informs; find = locate the `correct` hotspots, decoys are traps.

wrongNote.description: find mode: shown when the learner clicks a decoy.

x.description: Horizontal position as a PERCENTAGE of the image width (0 = left edge).

y.description: Vertical position as a PERCENTAGE of the image height (0 = top edge).

correct.description: find mode: true = a hotspot the learner must locate; false/absent = decoy.

branchingScenario.description: Conversation / decision tree (TalkMaster-style). The learner walks from `start` through `choices`; terminal nodes are endings. Always formative — it never touches the score.

start.description: Node id the scenario opens on.

label.description: The option text the learner clicks.

next.description: Target node id. Omit on a terminal choice.

feedback.description: Shown on the next node as the consequence of this choice (Safe HTML allowed).

correct.description: Marks the choice as the desirable one. Used for the debrief summary only — grading stays formative.
Ending only: true = the desirable outcome.

debrief.description: Ending only: what to take away from this path.

dragDropSet.description: Sort items into buckets. Click/tap to place (keyboard + touch) with pointer dragging as an enhancement. Always formative — checking shows feedback but never scores.

instructions.description: Short how-to line, e.g. 'Klik item lalu klik kategori.'

bucket.description: id of the bucket this item belongs to.

note.description: Shown after a correct placement / in the debrief.
